title: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy

claims.claim: Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang, Pazar günü eşini aldattığını itiraf etti.

evidence.quote: On Sunday, Huang admitted, external to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children.

claims.claim: Nvidia, Jensen Huang hakkındaki iddialara ilişkin bağımsız bir soruşturma başlattı.

evidence.quote: Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed.
